method: Chrome connector only. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked). Confirmed prior pass's finding that site is a pure kitchenware/tableware taxonomy with no room-based furniture department. Cross-checked category sitemap (sitemap_0.xml, 1479 <loc> entries) with a furniture-keyword regex (furniture|sofa|chair|table|bed|desk|cabinet|wardrobe|stool|bench|dresser|shelving|bookcase|seating|island|cart|stand|nightstand|ottoman|loveseat|sectional, word-boundary aware) after excluding 'sur-la-table' brand-name false positives. Only ONE genuinely furniture-typed category slug exists site-wide: /products/kitchen-decor/home-essentials/kitchen-islands-carts/ (all other hits were 'baking-cabinet' [food ingredient category], 'tablecloths-runners'/'tabletop' [linens] -- non-furniture). Verified /products/outdoor/ branch (27 URLs) has zero furniture nodes -- cookware, grilling, dining/glassware, linens, picnic/camping only. Site search for 'bar stool' returned only an OXO 'Bar Tool Set' (fuzzy match, no real bar stools) confirming genuine absence of stool/chair-type seating.
